conclusion: The blocked model acquisition is a local CLI HTTPS egress restriction, not evidence of a missing Hugging Face repository or browser login. The signed-in browser can inspect exact revisions, but it does not provide the runtime a credential or restore its blocked outbound socket path.
required_user_action: Restore local CLI HTTPS egress before exact-revision downloads can be performed and verified. Do not provide a Hugging Face token unless a gated repository later requires it.
